thread:
Maya: Quick sync on Optimize Toolkit launch gating — need to lock scope for the sprint. batching + caching + eval-alerts? quant recs maybe later?
Sam: +1 to prioritizing batching + caching first. those give the biggest unit-cost wins with lowest infra lift.
Diego: customers we talked to (FinCorp, Zephyr) specifically asked for quant recs to hit GPU cost targets. they’ll sign pilot only if quant guidance included.
Maya: noted. tradeoff: surface-level quant recommendations (model & q-level) vs full quantization pipelines. which minimal ship gives customer value?
Kelly: minimal quant guidance = static lookup table: model -> recommended quant config + expected perf delta. low infra, docs + examples. full autop-run quant pipelines is heavy.
Nina: SRE risk: adaptive batching interacts with autoscaler and can spike p95 if not constrained. need explicit latency SLO and canary plan.
Ava: UX: show recommendations inline in console. two states: "quick suggestion" (low confidence) and "validated" (from evals). we should avoid modal popups.
Sam: proposed MVP scope for sprint: (1) batching heuristics + runtime knobs, (2) prefix/KV caching API + console UI, (3) eval-triggered alert hooks (alert on quality regressions), (4) quant guidance table (doc only, no auto-run).
Diego: +1 but customer ask for quant examples. include a one-off notebook that shows quant tradeoffs for 1-2 models.
Maya: Launch criteria checklist (draft):
- 3 pilot customers onboarded and given guidance
- Performance: p50 token latency <200ms, p95 <800ms under pilot load
- Cost: demonstrable >=30% token-cost reduction in pilot using batching+cache vs baseline
- Quality: no more than 1% drop in evaluation metric (per-customer eval sets) OR documented opt-outs
- Ops: canary + rollback plan tested in staging
- Docs: console callouts + how-to notebook available
Sam: measurable signals we will emit for gating: batch_utilization, cache_hit_rate, tokens_per_second, eval_regressions_count, avg_cost_per_1k_tokens.
Nina: canary plan: rolling canary to 5% traffic with shadowed quant recommendations; monitor p95 and error rate for 48h, fallback to baseline if p95 increases >25% or errors >0.5%.
Kelly: scope negotiation: if we hit time constraints drop: the notebook OR the console inline validation (keep doc + console links).
Ava: for console mockups I’ll deliver two screens by Wed: (a) toolkit panel with recommended knobs, (b) evaluation alerts timeline.
Maya: owners: Sam -> runtime + batching, Diego -> quant guidance + notebook, Nina -> canary/runbook, Ava -> UI, Kelly -> docs + comms.
Sam: short config snippet I’ll prototype for batching heuristics:
```
batching:
  batch_window_ms: 20
  max_batch_size_tokens: 4096
  priority_threshold: 0.75
```
Diego: notebook will include a sample: fp16 vs int8 vs int4 throughput/cost table and suggested mapping per model family.
Maya: timeline: 3-week sprint to ship MVP scope (no automated quant pipelines). if pilots insist on automated quant then we'll scope a follow-up spike next sprint.
deploy-bot: Canary deployed to staging cluster for toolkit-v0.3. Monitor metrics at https://telemetry/internal/dashboards/opt-toolkit (alerts configured).
Maya: OK — final ask: each owner add 3 concrete acceptance tests to the ticket by EOD. I’ll consolidate and send to sales for pilot signoff. :rocket:
Sam: will do.
Diego: will add notebook PR with sample outputs.
Nina: I’ll add the runbook and canary playbook to the ticket.
Kelly: docs outline incoming.
Ava: mockups posted in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks team — synced.
